classes.name_en: Seanad Éireann, the five vocational panels
classes.note: 43 of the 60 senators are elected from five vocational panels (Art. 18.4.1) by the new Dáil, the outgoing Seanad, and every city and county councillor (Seanad Electoral (Panel Members) Act 1947 s.44(1)), by postal STV, within 90 days of a Dáil dissolution (Art. 18.8). Eleven more are nominated by the Taoiseach and are not elected.

classes.name: Seanad Éireann of the Irish Free State
classes.note: Under the 1922 Constitution one fourth of the senators were to be elected every three years by the whole Free State as one electoral area (Art. 32); the only such popular vote was in 1925. The 1928, 1931, and 1934 renewals were votes of Oireachtas members only (Constitution (Amendment No. 6) Act 1928). The Seanad was abolished in 1936 (Seanad Eireann (Consequential Provisions) Act 1936).

cadence.locator: https://www.irishstatutebook.ie/eli/1922/act/1/enacted/en/print.html (Art. 32: "One-fourth of the members of Seanad Eireann shall be elected every three years")
